{{Recipe summary
| Category = Confection recipes
| Time = 4–5 days
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 3 organic or unwaxed [[cookbook:oranges|oranges]] (Sevilles are good)
* 90 g [[cookbook:Caster Sugar|caster sugar]] (twice)
* 220 ml [[cookbook:water|water]] (twice)

== Procedure ==
#Peel just the skin of the washed, dried orange with a potato peeler (include only skin, no white pith).
#[[cookbook:Boil|Boil]] the peels in a syrup made from the sugar and water for 5 minutes. Remove peels from syrup.
#Dry peels on a wire rack for 4 hours.
#Boil peels again in a fresh syrup. Dry again on the wire rack until brittle (about 48 hours).
#Grind in a clean coffee grinder and store in a sealed container.

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Using a fan [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] set on the lowest setting (100 °C) with the door slightly ajar to allow free passage of air will dry the peel in under 8 hours.
